# 代码块语法着色

C++、Python 与 JSON 各一块，另有一块未知语言保持原样。

```cpp
// compute the answer
int total = 42;
const char* name = "keepmd";
return printf("%d\n", total);
```

```python
def greet(name):
    # greet the reader
    return f"Hello, {name}!"
```

```json
{
  "name": "KeepMD",
  "version": 6,
  "native": true
}
```

```text
plain block without a known language
```
